description: Na₃CoO₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.33 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.29 Å) and one longer (2.32 Å) Na-O bond length. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.44 Å. Co is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.76 Å) and two longer (1.77 Å) Co-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four Na and one Co atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Co trigonal bipyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Na and one Co atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Co trigonal bipyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Co atom.
